programme.title: Informatik Bachelor mit Nebenfach 30 ECTS (Bachelor/Ha … - LMU München
programme.degree: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.), 6 semesters, 150 ECTS main subject + 30 ECTS minor; winter start; locally restricted admission (NC)
programme.how_found: lmu.de 'Alle Studienfächer und Studiengänge' is JavaScript-only -> institute www.ifi.lmu.de -> Studium -> Studiengänge -> Bachelor 'Informatik' (bachelor_informatik) -> link 'Bachelor Informatik 150 mit Nebenfach im Umfang von 30 ECTS' to the central lmu.de programme page.
programme.notes: No English twin: the page itself says 'This page is not available in English. Sorry!'. The Informatik bachelor comes in three variants on lmu.de: 150+30 ECTS minor (2911, chosen: the plain 'Informatik' shape with the largest CS share among the 'Informatik Bachelor' pages), 120+60 ECTS minor (informatik-bachelor-mit-nebenfach-60-ects-bachelor-hauptfach-2916.html) and 'Informatik mit integriertem Anwendungsfach' 180 ECTS (…-26048.html; a joined 'Informatics and X' shape -> related). Medieninformatik and Bioinformatik are related, not the programme.

english.quote: TestDaF-Niveaustufe 4: The German as a Foreign Language test with a level 4 in all sections.
english.notes: German-taught; registration needs DSH 2, TestDaF 4 in all sections, telc C1 Hochschule or equivalent. Not an English requirement.

gpa.notes: Locally restricted admission (Numerus Clausus, 'Örtliche Zulassungsbeschränkung'); the cut-off is a past-cycle result, not a published minimum, and none was quoted.

deadline.quote: Application deadlines for the summer semester must be made by 15 January and for the winter semester by 15 July each year.
deadline.notes: International round: applications to the International Office (non-EU, all subjects). The date is printed without a year ('each year').

tuition.notes: Programme page: 'Die Universität erhebt für das Studentenwerk München den Grundbeitrag sowie den Solidarbeitrag Semesterticket.' — a Studierendenwerk contribution, not tuition; latest amount 'Sommersemester 2026: Grundbeitrag 97,00 €' (https://www.lmu.de/de/workspace-fuer-studierende/1x1-des-studiums/studierendenwerksbeitraege/). No tuition for non-EU students found on the programme page; not quoted as an amount.

scholarship_exists.quote: Die Förderung pro Stipendium beträgt 300 Euro im Monat
scholarship_exists.notes: Deutschlandstipendium at LMU: 300 EUR/month, usually for one year; merit-based and competitive; for enrolled LMU students (2026 call ran 16 March - 5 April 2026).

scholarship_international.quote: Bewerben können sich sowohl deutsche als auch internationale Studierende.
scholarship_international.notes: Also: 'Das Stipendium richtet sich an Studierende aller Nationalitäten'.
